testIds: TDD-SIM-NN-GNN-NN for blocker-level; TDD-R0-E2E-NN for cross-role

finance.amounts: synthetic controlled fixture only, neither market prices nor legal thresholds

blockerCases.given: Verified company signatory; valid delegation and exact issued quote hash
blockerCases.when: Actor signs using pilot-approved method with accepted terms
blockerCases.then: Only exact QuoteVersion transitions to ACCEPTED with immutable proof, otherwise remain ISSUED

blockerCases.given: Portal Viewer with requester capability but without separately verified signer authority
blockerCases.then: DENY; no QuoteVersion state or Outbox acceptance event

blockerCases.given: Quote ISSUED with expiry and parallel supersede command
blockerCases.then: Single authoritative valid transition; expired/superseded version cannot be accepted

blockerCases.given: Previously successful signatory acceptance and identical idempotency key
blockerCases.then: Same logical acceptance and evidence, no duplicate customer commitment/event

blockerCases.given: Authorized user from CustomerOrg-Y or provider Tenant-B but quote belongs to CustomerOrg-X
blockerCases.then: DENY and no terms/signature visibility

blockerCases.given: Current ISSUED QuoteVersion; customer has explicit decline authority
blockerCases.when: Customer declines with allowed reason and expectedVersion
blockerCases.then: QuoteVersion DECLINED with correct actor, audit and no Booking

blockerCases.given: Customer only has quote:read permission
blockerCases.then: DENY without state write or side effects

blockerCases.given: Authorized decline races customer acceptance and quote expiry
blockerCases.when: Both commands execute against same version
blockerCases.then: Exactly one lawful final transition; losers conflict/re-read

blockerCases.given: Decline recorded with same request digest
blockerCases.then: One logical decline/audit outcome, no duplicate outbound notifications

blockerCases.given: External customer from another provider relationship
blockerCases.then: DENY with no quote existence disclosure

blockerCases.given: User belongs to Tenant-B and separately to provider Tenant-A's CustomerAccount-X via grant
blockerCases.when: User opens permitted Tenant-A order from customer workspace
blockerCases.then: Only provider-scoped customer projection returned; no Tenant-A employee Membership

blockerCases.given: Same user switches browser context by caller-supplied tenantId header
blockerCases.when: Request Tenant-Z data using forged header
blockerCases.then: DENY, server-derived trusted context unaffected

blockerCases.given: Grant revocation and concurrent My Orders request
blockerCases.when: Provider disables CustomerAccount membership while read is in flight
blockerCases.then: New post-revoke authorization denies; in-flight semantics explicitly documented and DB-consistent

blockerCases.given: Cached customer projection created before revocation
blockerCases.when: User refreshes listing with active old JWT
blockerCases.then: No stale customer data leakage after authoritative revoke; 401/403 as appropriate

blockerCases.given: Two customers X/Y same provider Tenant-A
blockerCases.when: Customer X asks list/filter with Y order IDs
blockerCases.then: Only X's authorized subset; no count/fields from Y

blockerCases.given: Trip STARTED and active custody; subscription enters SUSPENDED
blockerCases.when: Authorized assigned driver records necessary POD/evidence under continuity policy
blockerCases.then: Safety/evidence permitted and auditable, no cargo evidence lost; new discretionary booking blocked

blockerCases.given: Tenant suspended and sales attempts new discretionary Booking
blockerCases.then: DENY under agreed SaaS policy while evidence/recovery operations remain available

blockerCases.given: Suspension transition races driver pickup/POD write
blockerCases.then: Deterministic scoped continuity guard, no orphan evidence/custody

blockerCases.given: SaaS service temporarily unreachable with safe-continuity policy version available
blockerCases.then: Idempotent evidence accepted only under valid preapproved continuity scope; logs decision

blockerCases.given: Suspended Tenant-A driver tries read another Tenant-B Trip
blockerCases.then: DENY; safe continuity does not grant cross-tenant access

blockerCases.given: Quote ISSUED, customer changes cargo weight
blockerCases.when: Sales submits versioned amendment, obtains approvals as configured
blockerCases.then: New QuoteVersion created, original immutable and prior assumptions invalidated explicitly

blockerCases.given: Quote ACCEPTED and stale RFQ edit request
blockerCases.when: Customer tries direct mutation to old QuoteVersion or active Booking
blockerCases.then: DENY; persisted change request only, no stealth contract mutation

blockerCases.given: Customer acceptance races issuance of replacement quote version
blockerCases.then: Only one coherent signed version remains effective; no mixed price/cargo snapshots

blockerCases.given: Identical amend request repeated after response timeout
blockerCases.then: One change proposal and one new version at most, no duplicate approval requests

blockerCases.given: Sales from unrelated legal entity attempts amendment
blockerCases.when: Submit change for foreign customer quote
blockerCases.then: DENY and no buy/sell details leak

blockerCases.given: CarrierOffer OFFERED then SELECTED and supplier confirms valid held vehicle
blockerCases.when: Fleet confirms exclusive reservation with correct carrier authority
blockerCases.then: Only CapacityReservation CONFIRMED authorizes Booking predicate; OFFER SELECTED alone does not

blockerCases.given: Carrier withdraws before reservation confirmation
blockerCases.when: Dispatcher attempts Booking.CONFIRMED based on SELECTED offer
blockerCases.then: DENY/resource pending and supplier exception; no fake capacity

blockerCases.given: Offer expiry/withdrawal races Fleet hold confirmation
blockerCases.then: No confirmation based on invalidated offer or stale authority; failure reconciled

blockerCases.given: Provider processes carrier acknowledge callback twice
blockerCases.then: Single logical carrier ack/reservation effect and versioned audit

blockerCases.given: Carrier-C receives buy offer with sell quote, margin and other carrier data
blockerCases.when: Carrier reads view via its grant
blockerCases.then: Only own offer/public shipment terms returned; provider margin/cross-carrier fields absent

blockerCases.given: Vehicle/driver/trailer free for specified UTC interval
blockerCases.when: Fleet commits HELD and validates confirmation
blockerCases.then: Single valid reservation and holdExpiry/version recorded atomically

blockerCases.given: Overlapping active reservation exists for same indivisible resource
blockerCases.then: DB enforces conflict, no second HELD/CONFIRMED

blockerCases.given: Two dispatchers and hold expiry job compete for same slot
blockerCases.then: At most one compatible final reservation; stale expiry cannot free confirmed hold

blockerCases.given: Crash after capacity transaction commits before notification
blockerCases.then: One authoritative reservation, eventual notification, no new capacity hold

blockerCases.given: Planner from ungranted Tenant-Z attempts Tenant-A vehicle hold
blockerCases.then: DENY before write; RLS still protects resource row

blockerCases.given: Cargo/route compliance assessed with qualified applicable rule source and reviewer
blockerCases.when: Qualified Compliance actor approves reviewed evidence
blockerCases.then: Versioned legally applicable permit/assessment permits allowed transition as configured

blockerCases.given: Critical jurisdiction/cargo permit status is UNKNOWN or DENY
blockerCases.then: DENY; pending HOLD with reason; no route/Trip READY/Booking allow

blockerCases.given: Permit expires between assessment and Trip READY
blockerCases.when: READY command checks current effective rule snapshot/version
blockerCases.then: DENY or requalification; no stale compliance approval

blockerCases.given: Late Compliance ALLOW event arrives after later DENY
blockerCases.then: No regression from DENY into ALLOW, emit reconciliation/audit

blockerCases.given: Reviewer with scope for another legal entity tries to release HOLD
blockerCases.then: DENY, full audit of attempted release

blockerCases.given: Assigned driver captures pickup evidence offline while valid assignment; server receives later
blockerCases.when: Upload event with assignment history/version and evidences
blockerCases.then: One validated historical custody transition after authoritative reconciliation

blockerCases.given: Reassigned/revoked driver forges new pickup observedAt after revocation
blockerCases.then: DENY for current state mutation; evidence quarantined if needed, not silently dropped or accepted

blockerCases.given: Two drivers submit overlapping cargo-unit custody transfers at same instant
blockerCases.when: Both commands compete on same CargoUnits
blockerCases.then: One legal custodian per unit, inconsistency quarantined with audit

blockerCases.given: Offline event resent five times after server crash
blockerCases.when: Replay same stable event ID, payload digest
blockerCases.then: Exactly one logical custody movement; no duplicate handover

blockerCases.given: Carrier driver has grant for Trip-1, attempts Trip-2 under different Tenant
blockerCases.then: DENY, no evidence leak or foreign cargo mutation

blockerCases.given: 10 CargoUnits in custody, consignee accepts 8 and refuses 2
blockerCases.then: 8 accepted, 2 retained with named custodian/disposition; Shipment not fully DELIVERED

blockerCases.given: Receiver with invalid link or mismatched units attempts mark all delivered
blockerCases.when: Submit POD for 10 though only 8 scanned/verified
blockerCases.then: DENY; no delivery proof for remaining 2

blockerCases.given: Driver and receiver concurrently submit overlapping POD/delivery attempts
blockerCases.when: POD acceptance races reattempt for 2 units
blockerCases.then: No double-counted accepted/returned quantities; per-unit conservation holds

blockerCases.given: Duplicate signed POD callback or offline photos arrive out of order
blockerCases.then: One logical accepted quantity; original signature immutable and correction append-only

blockerCases.given: Receiver guest token for one DeliveryAttempt accesses other shipment
blockerCases.then: DENY with no unrelated identity/cargo disclosure

blockerCases.given: Booking confirmed, no Trip started, customer submits cancel request
blockerCases.when: Booking owner evaluates policy, consent/charges and versions
blockerCases.then: Request separate from state; only authorized approval may CANCEL and release capacity with audit

blockerCases.given: Customer sees cancel button while Trip.STARTED with custody
blockerCases.then: Booking not directly CANCELLED; exception/recovery and cargo disposition required

blockerCases.given: Trip.STARTED occurs while cancellation approval commits
blockerCases.when: Both commands operate same Booking expectedVersion
blockerCases.then: One coherent outcome; no vehicle released with active custody

blockerCases.given: Cancellation request and compensation event retransmitted
blockerCases.then: One cancel request and at most one authorized compensation/release effect

blockerCases.given: Customer from different provider relationship requests cancellation
blockerCases.then: DENY; booking/tariff hidden

blockerCases.given: Invoice issued, approved payable, verified bank transaction matches currency and legal entity
blockerCases.then: Balance settles only to extent of verified allocated cash, independent of approval

blockerCases.given: Finance user clicks Paid without bank/ERP evidence
blockerCases.then: DENY; no accounting state mutation; audit attempted manual override

blockerCases.given: Two workers process same bank reference simultaneously
blockerCases.then: One unique allocation, no overpayment or duplicate settlement

blockerCases.given: Bank callback delivered again after successful response
blockerCases.when: Inbox replays payment transaction with same verified source key
blockerCases.then: No second allocation or income recognition, original proof preserved

blockerCases.given: Finance user from Tenant-B submits payment source reference belonging Tenant-A
blockerCases.then: DENY, no financial detail leak and per legal entity accounts remain separate

crossRoleCases.journey: CustomerOrg-X invited -> RFQ -> provider inbox -> quote approved -> customer acceptance
crossRoleCases.then: Customer sees own business objects; provider sees only allowed queue; no Booked until capacity

crossRoleCases.journey: Forwarder + external carrier -> offer -> capacity hold -> confirmed booking
crossRoleCases.then: Customer can see Booking confirmed only after authoritative Fleet and compliance verification

crossRoleCases.journey: Own fleet instead of external carrier
crossRoleCases.then: No fake CarrierOffer required, same exclusive reservation invariants

crossRoleCases.journey: Driver online/offline pickup -> partial POD 8/10 -> remaining returned
crossRoleCases.then: Cargo conservation and original proof immutable; track customer-safe statuses
Request-only separation and correct compensation/custody branch

crossRoleCases.journey: Payable approved -> advance + partial bank receipt + duplicate callback
crossRoleCases.then: No false Paid, unique allocations and money precision

crossRoleCases.journey: Subscription suspended while active custody and mandatory POD pending
crossRoleCases.then: Only approved safety continuity, no new discretionary booking, no cargo evidence stranded

crossRoleCases.journey: Provider staff phone RFQ and explicit later customer acceptance
crossRoleCases.then: Captured request provenance distinct from customer signatory; no forged approval

crossRoleCases.journey: Revoke CustomerAccount grant while read cache and signed link active
crossRoleCases.then: Future protected API denies; signed URL TTL semantics explicit

crossRoleCases.journey: Carrier withdraws after customer accepted quote before/after hold
crossRoleCases.then: Booking never falsely confirmed; exception and replacement sourced safely

testQualityGates: Each business-critical command must have negative and stale version tests
Use Java JUnit5/AssertJ/Mockito only for pure decisions
Use Spring Modulith boundary verification for source ownership
Use PostgreSQL/PostGIS Testcontainers, RLS and real concurrent transactions for data correctness
Use Outbox/Inbox replay to verify at-least-once delivery and dedup
Use HTTP response field assertions for client/carrier visibility
Record exact SHA, database migrations, fixture hash, CI evidence and real business/legal signoff separately
noClaim: NO CODE TESTS OR CI EXECUTED
